buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA 1. The contractor/vendor who has successfully completed Services for Fabrication/Press work of any type o f ammunition boxes/carrier will be considered eligible to participate in tender. 2. The contractor/vendor are required to submit proof of successfully completed similar type of supply orde rs through tendering in the past in any Ordnance Factories. 3. Definition of Similar work : “Similar work” shall mean the Fabrication/welding/assembly or allied work of sheet-metal/steel components, ammunition boxes, crates, containers or similar fabricated items. 4. The contractor shall confirm availability of adequate skilled manpower, welding machines, tools and oth er necessary equipment required for execution of the work as per the Scope of work enclosed with the ten der and to achieve the stipulated production requirement. 5. The firm shall submit compliance to Scope of Work/Annexure ATC and other terms & conditions of the te nder duly signed and stamped. 6. Non compliance with the above pre qualification criteria or non submission of the required supporting do cuments may render the offer liable for rejection.

7. Tender without submission of above supporting documents will be summarily rejected and no further co rrespondence in this regard will be made. Note: 01 Service includes Assembly Bracket Cross/Side Assembly of Bracket Cross and Bracket Side with s upport for Bracket Side for Box C-51A and C52A for Qty. 89685 nos. Firm has to quote accordingly. SUBMISSION OF COMPLIANCE AS PER BID CONDITIONS AND ACCEPTANCE OF ATC 1. Specification : 01 Service includes Assembly Bracket Cross/Side Assembly of Bracket Cross and Bracket Side with support for Bracket Side for Box C-51A and C52A for Qty. 89685 nos. Firm has to quote accordin gly. 2. Scope of work/Terms and Conditions : As per Annexure “A” attached. 3. Delivery Period : As per GeM 4. Option Clause : As per GeM. 5. Earnest Money Deposit : As per GeM. 6. Performance Security Deposit : As per GeM. 7. Pre-Qualification Criteria : As per Annexure attached. 8. Warranty : Compliance of warranty for minimum 12 months period from final acceptance date of materi al. 9. Payment Terms : Payment will be made on monthly basis within 30 days after submission of Job Comple tion Certificate (JCC) along with the supporting documents i.e. Tax Invoice and submission of Tax Return/IF F on GST portal. 10. Non-involvement in cartel formation : We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cart el with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIM ITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 11. Bidder Financial Standing : We hereby give an undertaking that “We are not under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceeding and not bankrupt”. 12. Inspection :Authorized representative of ED/OFBH on receipt of material at O.F. Bhusawal. 13. SAFETY NORMS: The firm shall fulfill all safety norms of OFBH and shall provide all necessary PPEs as p er requirement of the job. During execution of work if Firm’s employees are not following safety norms or f ound without required PPEs, then penalty of Rs. 1000/- per incident will be charge. Penalty amount will be deducted by concern user section at the time of preparation of JCC 14. ATC Clause : I accept all Bid terms & conditions along with Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditio ns(ATC) and also, Buyer Added Text Based ATC clauses as per above referred GEM Bid. ANNEXURE -“A” Works details Terms & Condition for Complete Manufacturing ASSEMBLY BRACKET CROSS/SIDE BOX 51A 1. SCOPE OF WORK: The firm has to carryout the work of complete manufacturing Assembly Bracket Cross/ Side at O.F. Bhusawal premises. The firm shall provide adequate labors of required skill to carry out the job as per scope of work along with technical supervisor to monitor and control the work. The firm has to do following work :- a. Collection of raw material from concerned godown. b. Welding and assemble Bracket Cross/ Side. c. Finishing/ removal of burrs d. Carry out inspection of Bracket Cross/Side in supervision with QC examiner or shop staff. e. After inspection, Bracket Side to hand over to shop staff by proper stacking at storage location. 2. WORK SHIFT: - The firm shall carry out the subject job daily inside the factory from 8.00 AM up to 5.00 P M (with 45 Minutes lunch from 12:30 Hours to 13:15 Hours). The shift time may vary round the clock as per the availability of the infrastructure and requirement. The firm may be asked t o work in more than one shift (if required). 3. DELIVERY: - The firm should have manufacture and provide least 500 Nos. of Bracket Cross/Side per day . In case of increased demands, the contractor will have to provide additional workers to meet the day to day requirement. Contractor shall start manufacturing Bracket Side within 3 days from the date of intimation. If contractor fails to start the work within 3 days of intimation, pe nalty will be imposed on the firm as per penalty clause. 4. QUALITY: - The job must comply with the quality requirements of Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Rectificati on: Rectification, if any, shall have to be carried out by the firm. The rectification job shall not be counted separately. 5. PAYMENT& MAINTENANCE OF RECORDS:- The firm shall maintain following records on daily basis (or at appropriate frequency as per case), which must be endorsed by Representative of Ordnance Factory Bhus awal :- a. Oty of Sheet (raw material) lifted from Concerned godown b. Oty of Bracket Side made per day. c. Qty of Bracket Side Passed by QC/OFBH d. Daily attendance i.e. name and signatures of the Workmen of firm reporting on daily basis e. JCC will be provided on the monthly basis, on a mutually agreed date.

6. MATERIAL & INFRASTRUCTURE:- Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall provide : a. Necessary raw material components. b. Necessary consumables. c. Required Plant and machinery, Welding machine, Welding rod, Hand grinder, Grinding/Cutting wheel. d. Place for working. e. Hand trolley or other vehicle as per availability will be provided by OFBh. f. Bins to keep the components. g. Measuring equipment h. Necessary drawings. I. All testing facilities and equipments. 7. SAFETY & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS: a. The firm shall fulfill all safety norms and shall provide all necessary safety equipment e.g. safety shoes, hand gloves etc. as per the requirement of the job. b. The firm shall fulfill al security requirements and shall not violate any of the rules and regulations of the factory. c. The firm must arrange for Police Verification Report of laborers, which the firm is going to engage for the subject work and submit the PVR to Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. d. The firm has to obey all labor laws and statutory rules applicable for above job e.g. Minimum Wages Act, Child Labor Act etc. e. Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall not be responsible for any loss damage to the firm and/or his men/ma chines during the course of work. f. In case of any dispute, decision of the Executive Director, O.F. Bhusawal will be final and binding. g. Working area and surroundings will be cleaned by contractor on daily basis. h Whatever the equipment or machinery is provided by the factory for conducting the production work will have to be submitted after completion of the entire S.O. quantity and get it cleared from the concerned se ction. 8. PENALTY: - a. If the firm will not be able to deliver as per the delivery requirement of O. F. Bhusawal due to fault on fir ms side, firm will be liable for a penalty of 1/3rd of the Supply Order job Rate per Bracket Side for the shortfall quantity in delivery on daily basis, limited to the maximum of tot al Supply Order rate of the job. The penalty will be calculated on daily basis and will be integrated if necessary for any shortfall in delivery. b. Any regular poor performance in delivery or in point of view of quality aspect etc. O. F.Bhusawal has full right to short close the S.O. along with penalty. c. If the housekeeping and cleanliness of the work place (If required with the nature of work) of contractor i s not found satisfactory, a penalty may be imposed @ 1/10thof the Supply Order Job Rate per no. of Bracket Side produced during the period in which housekeeping and clea nliness had not been carried out, limited to the maximum of 1/10th of total Supply Order rate of the job. 9. Important a. Aforesaid scope of work shall also include work which is not mentioned above but essentially required to meet the requirement, quantity, quality, safety etc. b. Any Loss or damage to the Infrastructure (machines, components etc.) due to fault of firm or its workm en shall have to be borne by the firm. c. Any time loss or any idle time, of labour of contractor, due to unavailability of material/processes etc. wil l have to be borne by contractor only. d. The firm shall make their own necessary arrangements for stay in the Bhusawal. e. Supplier shall maintain proper cleanliness work area and its surroundings. f. Note: It is recommended that before quoting, the firm should visit Ordnance Factory Bhusawal to unders tand the job requirement and real assessment of work. For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procurem ent manual available of YIL site : yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library In case of any query/information please contact at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552,222907, Extn 241 . 5.
